captions.text: Same B6 contingency. Left: no response. Right: linear-programming optimiser.
Before the outage: demand is served in both runs. Line colours show corridor loading.
Half-hour snapshots advance together. Arrowheads show the direction of electricity flow.
Surplus Scottish wind is exported over B6 towards England.
Inspecting SSCO-NORT: flow and capacity come from the API.
B6 trips at 17:00 UTC on 14 Dec 2025. Scotland is cut off from England.
Scotland is islanded WITH SURPLUS wind and stays supplied. Curtailment shows spare generation.
No response: all eight England and Wales zones, NORT through SOUT, develop shortfalls.
The optimiser keeps demand served, with no red overloaded lines throughout the episode.
0 MWh unserved at dashboard precision across the full episode.
Full episode: 63,917 vs 0 MWh unserved. Costs: £388.5M vs £17.4M.
Optimiser model penalty: £0.0M. Model penalties remain separate from cost.
RL policies were also trained; they did not beat the optimiser.
